status: effective finite-height signed adjacent-cutoff projective splice for the retained first-order real-edge model
proof_boundary: This proves the adjacent-cutoff signed splice only for the retained first-order real-edge model. It does not bound the higher-order Xi/source contribution, prove an Xi-level edge sign, cumulative-minor estimate, Abel-scalar gap, successor winding cap, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or a prize-level conclusion.

published_source.citation: D.H.J. Polymath, Effective approximation of heat flow evolution of the Riemann xi function, and a new upper bound for the de Bruijn-Newman constant, arXiv:1904.12438
published_source.location: equation (53), C_0, first correction, and Proposition 6.2

exact.domain: L>=50, 0<tL<=25, h=1/a<1/72000000000; at an integer cutoff a=m compare p_minus=-1 in the N=m-1 chart with p_plus=1 in the N=m chart
exact.physical_alignment: S_minus=kappa_(m-1)T_0, S_plus=kappa_mT_0=-S_minus; v_minus=(C_minus/S_minus,D_minus/S_minus), v_plus=(C_plus/S_plus,D_plus/S_plus). Real nonzero rescaling does not change the projective points, and c_minus,c_plus<0 select their common short lift.
exact.finite_jets: c_sigma=A_sigma+h e0_sigma, |e0_sigma|<100; d_sigma=h B_sigma+h^2 e1_sigma, |e1_sigma|<250, sigma in {minus,plus}
exact.pi_provenance: The endpoint A and B formulas inherit pi from the completed-zeta and Riemann-Siegel C_0 normalization. Evaluation at p=+-1 reduces that source phase to square radicals; no geometric circle, polygon, or fitted constant is introduced.

rows.claim: Each canonical adjacent cutoff lies in one common high-height box.
rows.formula: L>=50, 0<tL<=25, h=1/a<1/72000000000; at an integer cutoff a=m compare p_minus=-1 in the N=m-1 chart with p_plus=1 in the N=m chart
rows.proof_boundary: The statement concerns the retained first-order edge model.

rows.claim: The alternating endpoint normalizer is harmless in real projective space.
rows.formula: S_minus=kappa_(m-1)T_0, S_plus=kappa_mT_0=-S_minus; v_minus=(C_minus/S_minus,D_minus/S_minus), v_plus=(C_plus/S_plus,D_plus/S_plus). Real nonzero rescaling does not change the projective points, and c_minus,c_plus<0 select their common short lift.
rows.proof_boundary: The aligned normalized rows, not the antipodal physical representatives, define the short join.

rows.claim: The two cutoff endpoint values agree and their first slopes have an exact gap.
rows.proof_boundary: These are exact evaluations of the published C_0 source formulas.

rows.claim: The limiting cutoff connector is strictly clockwise.
rows.proof_boundary: No numerical sign fitting is used.

rows.claim: Only the value and centered-slope edge jets are needed at a cutoff connector.
rows.formula: c_sigma=A_sigma+h e0_sigma, |e0_sigma|<100; d_sigma=h B_sigma+h^2 e1_sigma, |e1_sigma|<250, sigma in {minus,plus}
rows.proof_boundary: The x-second jet is needed for within-cell current, not for the join-parameter current.

rows.claim: The finite connector determinant has an exact polynomial remainder.
rows.proof_boundary: No division by either endpoint row occurs.

rows.claim: The O(h^2) connector error cannot consume the radical margin.
rows.proof_boundary: All finite-height constants are inherited from the critical-ray gate.

rows.claim: Every retained-model adjacent edge connector has strict negative projective current.
rows.proof_boundary: This signs the connector, not the omitted Xi/source remainder.

rows.claim: The affine connector remains in one nonzero projective chart.
rows.proof_boundary: The join cannot pass through the origin.

rows.claim: The affine join has constant signed projective current.
rows.formula: v_s=(1-s)v_minus+s v_plus; c_s*d_(s)-d_s*c_(s)=Delta_cut; For v_s=(c_s,d_s), partial_s arg(c_s+i d_s)=Delta_cut/(c_s^2+d_s^2)<0
rows.proof_boundary: The join parameter s is distinct from the physical x derivative.

rows.claim: The result closes every q>=1 cutoff splice in the retained critical-ray model.
rows.formula: q=2tL^2>=1 is a subset of L>=50, 0<tL<=25
rows.proof_boundary: Insertion into the cumulative contact scalar remains separate.

rows.claim: The model splice is not an Xi-level or global contact theorem.
rows.formula: Higher-order Xi/source error and the cumulative signed-minor estimate remain open.
rows.proof_boundary: No Xi-level edge sign, Abel gap, winding cap, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, or RH is claimed.
